## FILE_GRANT_TTL_MS variable

How long a file grant can be exchanged for the file: 15 minutes from issue.

**Signature:**

```typescript
FILE_GRANT_TTL_MS: number
```

## Remarks

A grant is issued when an authorized operation returns a file. Fifteen minutes covers an agent that inspects a result before fetching it, while keeping a leaked grant useless soon. A grant is reusable until it expires, and only the subject it was issued to can use it.
